eventstore_contract.append_gate: append requires integrity in [:verified, :empty_verified] AND a freshly re-read, fully verified history; loss of intactness returns {:error, {:store_integrity_failure, reason}} and writes nothing
eventstore_contract.write_failure_semantics: any write failure poisons the store, does not advance count/sequence/digest, and never acknowledges success; subsequent appends return :store_poisoned; the store remains :poisoned until restarted and the complete history verifies
eventstore_contract.sync_failure_semantics: an fsync failure poisons the store the same way; the committed frame may or may not have reached storage — durable acknowledgement was withheld and no success is reported; restart against the actual file classifies it from the bytes on disk
eventstore_contract.partial_write_semantics: the fault seam writes a genuine prefix of the frame; restart against the real truncated file yields :truncated and refuses append

registry_contract.candidate_validation: every efdi.forecast.resolved event must pass semantic validation (required fields, forecast identity, scores payload); any failure halts recovery before publication; non-resolution events are skipped
registry_contract.publication: single ETS object {:__resolution_index__, %{forecast_id => resolution}} inserted atomically; failure yields :publication_failure and leaves no authoritative index
registry_contract.trust_gate: get/all_ids/count/commit require a live verified EventStore (integrity in [:verified, :empty_verified], not poisoned, appendable, not degraded) plus a published registry; otherwise :registry_not_verified, :registry_degraded or :eventstore_unavailable
